Dont trade anything in those boxes... Look for trade from 1am to 4am NY time above or below the blue box which is the asian session which is also outside the box, this is the time they hunt stops. Evryone was taught to trade breakout. So since the massive are trading breakout, if i were the market, i would trigger their entries and reverse. Then the next trade for continuation or reversal happens from 7:30am to 11am NY time. the reason i use m15 is for entries and its my trading frame. SND bases i look in H1 and above. They wont trade the same direction for 3 consecutive sessions. Unless the higher tf permits a direction then you may hold the trade. Else just end the trade earlier before 5pm NY as and intraday trade. Do note that timing are just guidelines and not fixed, else the percentage of winners will be 95% instead of 5%. The market rewards the 95% 1 out of the 3 attempt in order for them to stay in the market. With such mindset when a breakout trader wins, will make him feel that his methods works and continue to do what he does. Thats why we are taught to trade 1 to 3% of our equity. Its all about emotions which is 60% of the time. Strategy is only 10% and money management is 30%....

If you can understand stop hunts on a daily basis, you will be able to capture 50 pips almost everyday and by compounding only 3% per trade, you can turn a $5k account to $225k in 50 trades or lets say 10 weeks.try to measure your daily candle from wick to wick and see if you are able to get 50 pips or more. So who says picking tops and bottom is impossible? You just need to learn how its being made and capture it.

Mark your Yesterday high and yesterday low, weekly high and low, monthly high and low and asian session high and low everyday and u will be able to see how price reacts to these as stop hunts.
